It's actually the structure of the .zip file!
All files are stored as full paths, and it contains no directory entries.

### That is still a legal .zip !
:)

It was created with `System.IO.Compression.ZipArchive` in .NET.
`CreateEntry`only adds the entries (this is whatI used). But `ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory` and Windows PowerShell `Compress-Archive` do the same.
